title: Orchestrator header carries no shell tools
requirement: The orchestrator preset must not receive a shell: its request header carries read/write/edit but no bash and no pwsh, so the host policy that says "you have NO shell" matches the tool surface. Other presets keep their deny lists unchanged.
reason: A real emitted header needs a booted server with an orchestrator-preset chat; the live :3080 may not be restarted and the probe server's new chat did not flush a session log inside the timebox. The observed proof instead runs the installed plugin's own decide() over the real composed config and the real 98 host-plane tool names from the live orchestrator header, which is the same decision the next boot applies.
steps: Read the live orchestrator header: zstd -dc $DSH_HOME/sessions/--home-iustimov-dsh-kit--/session-ed90220d-.../session.v4.jsonl.zstd and take the last request/header tool names (98 names, `bash` present).
Add 'bash' and 'pwsh' to the orchestrator deny list in profile/cordis.patch.yml (tool-families row).
Run: node /tmp/proof-tool-families.mjs - it imports the installed @cc/dsh-tool-families decide()/normalizeConfig, composes the shipped config, and replays the real header names.
Confirm: deny=['bash'], surface 97, write/edit/read present, bash absent, pwsh absent; every other preset's deny list identical before/after.
Converge: the next `dsh` launch runs kit-update and writes the profile patch (kit-update --check plans write-profile-files).
expected: A fresh orchestrator request header carries read/write/edit and zero bash/pwsh entries: the tool-families row resolves `bash` into its deny list, `pwsh` is unmatched on Linux (denied by name on Windows), the surface drops exactly that one tool from 98 to 97, and every other preset's deny list is unchanged.

history.notes: Red is the live header itself (session-ed90220d seq 1502, 98 tools, `bash` present, `pwsh` absent on Linux). Green is the decision the next boot applies. A real emitted header on a restarted server is the remaining check: after the next `dsh` launch, grep the newest request/header of a fresh orchestrator chat for bash. The probe server on :3082 loaded the overlay (its ux chat showed 0 mcp__godot__ tools, i.e. projectDeny was applied), so the composition path is exercised; only the orchestrator-preset chat could not be produced in the timebox (the new chat took the workspace's remembered `ux` preset).
